messages:
tess: Quick bug — Go sampleapp throws typed RateLimitError with RetryAfterMs, but Python sample still surfaces requests.HTTPError for 429s. This breaks parity in our onboarding.

omar: Oof. Which example? the basic generate sample?

tess: Yep /v1/generate sync. Go: `err.(*errors.RateLimit).RetryAfterMs == 1500`. Python: `raise_for_status()` -> HTTPError, no structured fields.

jin: We should standardize a server error envelope and have SDKs normalize legacy shapes into exception subclasses. Envelope suggestion: `{error:{message,code,retry_after_ms,retryable,meta}}` (server only). SDKs normalize both old and new.

omar: Agreed. Plan: add NormalizeError(resp) helper in each SDK that returns a typed APIError subclass with attributes `.code`, `.retry_after_ms`, `.retryable`, `.http_status`.

tess: Also add sampleapp e2e that hits a toy fixture server returning both legacy/plaintext and envelope responses and assert exception parity.

ci-bot: Created task INFR-1611: "SDK error normalization + sampleapp parity e2e" assigned to omar,jin. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFR-1611

jin: I'll take Python normalizer + docs snippet. ETA Wed. omar: you want Go?

omar: Yep, I'll update Go sample + tests. ETA Tue.
tess: Great. Also add note: keep user-safe `message` and put internal debug into `meta`.

jin: We'll provide an opt-in `normalize_errors=true` in a minor release, flip default in next major to avoid surprise.

tess: Thanks — I'll paste reproducible curl and logs into the ticket.
